items.title: The Invisible Lottery: How Subtle Cues Steer Algorithm Choice in LLM Code Generation
items.quote: We define algorithm steering as cue-induced shifts in algorithm-family distributions and run 46,535 controlled experiments across 11 tasks
items.relation: behavioural default-algorithm steering by incidental cues under fixed correctness; no literal multi-name bans, no activation geometry

items.title: Benchmarking Language Model Creativity: A Case Study on Code Generation (NeoCoder, NAACL 2025)
items.quote: We introduce DENIAL PROMPTING which pushes LLMs to develop more creative solutions to a given prob
items.relation: technique-level bans (denial prompting) to elicit creative code; behavioural only, frontier models, no per-model mechanism labels or manifold landing

items.title: Manifold Steering Reveals the Shared Geometry of Neural Network Representation and Behavior
items.quote: we test whether interventions that respect the geometry of activation space will yield behaviors close to those the model exhibits naturally
items.relation: activation-manifold vs behaviour-manifold link via interventions; our landing test is correlational and uses prohibition, not steering

items.title: Language Models Represent and Transform Concepts with Shared Geometry
items.quote: Across six model families of varying scales, we find that context moves each concept differently.
items.relation: context-induced displacement of concept point-cloud manifolds; not algorithm choice under bans

items.title: AlgoTrace: Algorithmic Primitives and Compositional Geometry of Reasoning in Language Models (ICML 2026)
items.quote: We operationalize primitives by clustering latent activations of the model when solving four benchmarks: Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP), 3SAT, AIME, and Graph Navigation.
items.relation: geometry of algorithmic primitives inside reasoning traces; no catalogue of named path-search algorithms, no ban/landing test

items.title: Beyond Linear Concepts: Discovering and Aligning Non-Linear Concept Manifolds in Large Language Models
items.relation: method for non-linear concept manifolds; no behavioural prohibition

items.title: Formalize, Don't Optimize: The Heuristic Trap in LLM-Generated Combinatorial Solvers
items.quote: evaluate three solver-construction paradigms: native algorithmic search (Python), constraint modeling through a Python solver API (Python + OR-Tools), and declarative constraint mod
items.relation: solver-synthesis paradigms for combinatorial problems; no algorithm bans or default-choice study

overall: No retrieved work occupies the combination tested here (a multi-model screen of a literal five-name algorithm ban with mechanism-level labels, plus survivor landing on an activation manifold of the algorithm catalogue). Behavioural neighbours (Invisible Lottery, NeoCoder denial prompting) and geometry neighbours (Manifold Steering, shared concept geometry, AlgoTrace) are adjacent.
